label: Black Scarab estimated compensation
basis: advertised annual salary, excluding bonus and equity
method: One annual salary-range midpoint per distinct eligible requisition, then the median. No seniority pay bands inferred.
eligibility: U.S. roles developing production robot/vehicle firmware, hardware drivers, embedded Linux/BSPs, actuation/power firmware or embedded avionics, with complete explicit annual USD ranges.
limitations: Purposive employer sample with uneven coverage and mixed seniority, including a new-graduate advertisement and senior/staff roles. Excludes primarily integration, infotainment, test-only work, mixed geography and unverified annual salary periods. Structured salary fields do not consistently identify base pay. Not an entry-level estimate or representative market median.
